result: An explicit four-dimensional subspace S of 4x4 matrices has no nonzero Schmidt-rank<=2 vector, yet EVERY 2-block-positive witness of the natural form W_lambda=lambda I-P_S is completely copositive and strictly positive on every normalized 4x4 PPT state. Arbitrary local product congruences remain coCP, although singular ones need not remain strictly positive. Thus this maximally high-rank subspace does not by itself furnish a PPT/SN3 witness. This is one concrete construction barrier, not a classification of all subspaces or witnesses.
subspace: Identify 4x4 matrices with bipartite kets and put S=span{I4, D, U, L}, where D=diag(-3,-1,1,3), U has ones on the first superdiagonal, and L=U^T. If the U coefficient u is nonzero, the 3x3 minor using rows0,1,2 and columns1,2,3 is u^3. If u=0 but the L coefficient l is nonzero, the minor using rows1,2,3 and columns0,1,2 is l^3. If u=l=0, a nonzero aI+bD has at most one zero diagonal entry, hence rank>=3. Thus every nonzero vector in S has SR>=3.
maximality: As a standard algebraic-geometric import, the projective 4x4 rank<=2 determinantal variety has dimension11 in P^15. The projective dimension theorem forces every P^4, corresponding to a 5-dimensional matrix subspace, to meet it. Therefore an all-nonzero-rank>=3 complex subspace has dimension at most4, so this S is dimension-maximal. The witness no-go below does not depend on maximality.
projector: The four generators are mutually Frobenius-orthogonal. Hence the orthogonal projector is P_S=(1/4)[I4]+(1/20)[D]+(1/3)[U]+(1/3)[L], where [M] is the projector onto vec(M). Exact Fraction elimination verifies P_S^2=P_S and P_S^Gamma<= (11/15) I_16; equality holds on |01>+|10>. Therefore every normalized PPT rho obeys tr(P_S rho)=tr(P_S^Gamma rho^Gamma)<=11/15.
rank_two_test: The SR2 ket q=-|00>+|33> has squared norm2 and <q|P_S|q>=9/5, so the normalized overlap is9/10. Any 2-block-positive W_lambda=lambda I-P_S must satisfy lambda>=9/10. Consequently W_lambda^Gamma=lambda I-P_S^Gamma >=(9/10-11/15)I=(1/6)I>0. It is coCP and has strictly positive expectation on every normalized PPT state. This uses only the displayed rank2 test, not an asserted exact maximum over all rank2 kets.

exact_check.observed: Fraction arithmetic checks all256 entries of P_S^2=P_S, rank4, PSD of (11/15)I-P_S^Gamma by14 positive pivots and zero remainder, an exact eigenvector |01>+|10> at 11/15, and the rank2 test value9/5. The all-complex subspace rank proof is the displayed minor argument.

limits: The obstruction is only for scalar-identity offsets of this particular projector and their local congruences. It neither rules out other rank3 subspaces nor arbitrary positive metrics/multiple-observable witnesses or the unrestricted 4x4 problem. No independent external/formal review or novelty clearance.
